goal: Allow IPC mining clients to submit and prefer a block over equal-work tips in a single call
Prevent race conditions against concurrent chain activations and remove extra RPC round-trips
reviewability: Ready for review now, though a mechanical rebase on master is needed
agreement: Strong concept support for atomically submitting and preferring blocks
Enables single-call submission instead of a separate preciousblock RPC call (pablomartin4btc)
Rational for miners to prefer their own blocks over competing tips (Sjors, ViniciusCestarii, johnnyasantoss)
Addressed objection on duplicate return handling when marking known blocks precious (Sjors)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because IPC mining clients can atomically submit and prefer blocks without racing other chain activations
It eliminates extra round-trips to the preciousblock RPC when resolving equal-work tips
